tests.name: Count new and increasing call series, dedupe per email, and exclude idle or never-opened users from LLM activity

promql_expr_test.expr: (count(count by (user_email) (last_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{user_email=~".+",axon_workflow_name=~".*"}[1d]) > (last_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{user_email=~".+",axon_workflow_name=~".*"}[1w] offset 1d) or (0 * last_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{user_email=~".+",axon_workflow_name=~".*"}[1d]))))) or vector(0)) and on() ((day_of_week(vector(time() + 43200)) == 1) or on() (label_replace(vector(1), "trend", "1d", "", "") unless on(trend) label_replace(vector(1), "trend", "1w", "", "")))

(count(count by (user_email) (count_over_time(pi_session_started_total{user_email=~".+",axon_workflow_name=~".*"}[1d])) unless on (user_email) count by (user_email) (last_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{user_email=~".+",axon_workflow_name=~".*"}[1d]) > (last_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{user_email=~".+",axon_workflow_name=~".*"}[1w] offset 1d) or (0 * last_over_time(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{user_email=~".+",axon_workflow_name=~".*"}[1d]))))) or vector(0)) and on() ((day_of_week(vector(time() + 43200)) == 1) or on() (label_replace(vector(1), "trend", "1d", "", "") unless on(trend) label_replace(vector(1), "trend", "1w", "", "")))
